statements.statement: The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease
The service is ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the requested service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
